study: Fancsali et al. 2015, RAISE / Reading Apprenticeship (Empirical Education)
delivery_evidence: Teachers received 65 hrs inquiry-based Reading Apprenticeship PD over 12 months plus monthly on-site team meetings and on-site teacher-leader support (>85% of observed in-person sessions met design criteria); only an administrator course was online (Intervention/PD section; fidelity findings).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome = ETS scenario-based disciplinary-literacy assessment 'developed by ETS for this study... designed to measure the strategic reading processes that are primary targets of Reading Apprenticeship' (Key Findings section) - researcher/developer-made, proximal to intervention content.
curriculum_evidence: Reading Apprenticeship is an 'instructional framework' woven into existing subject-area (ELA/science/history) teaching via metacognitive conversation, not a new curriculum/materials package (framework description; Intervention section).
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted full-sample effects = spring Year 2, end of the full 65-hr/10-day PD dose (all 42 schools); Year 1/Year 3 waves not the primary post-treatment contrast (p.45 Table 13; design).
